definitions.explanation: The exit or entrance on the north side of a building, typically a train station. Japanese stations commonly label exits by compass direction.

examples.japanese: {北口|きたぐち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{待|ま}っています→待つ：00469_matsu⟧。
examples.english: I'll be waiting at the north exit.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{北口|きたぐち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦{右|みぎ}→右：02257_migi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{曲|ま}がって→曲がる：00649_magaru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Go out the north exit of the station and turn right.

examples.japanese: {北口|きたぐち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦バス{停|てい}→バス停：05295_basutei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a bus stop in front of the north exit.

notes:
{北口|きたぐち} means the north exit or entrance, most commonly of a train station. Japanese stations typically label exits by compass direction to help people navigate.

FORMS:
⟦{北|きた}→北：00644_kita⟧ (north) + {口|ぐち} (exit/entrance, with rendaku from くち)

STATION EXIT SET:
- {北口|きたぐち}: north exit
- ⟦{南口|みなみぐち}→南口：24066_minamiguchi⟧: south exit
- ⟦{東口|ひがしぐち}→東口：24067_higashiguchi⟧: east exit
- ⟦{西口|にしぐち}→西口：21655_nishiguchi⟧: west exit

OTHER ～{口|ぐち} COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{改札口|かいさつぐち}→改札口：09552_kaisatsuguchi⟧: ticket gate
- ⟦{出口|でぐち}→出口：02508_deguchi⟧: exit
- {入口|いりぐち}: entrance
- {中央口|ちゅうおうぐち}: central exit

USAGE:
Very common when giving directions to meet someone, especially at stations: 「{北口|きたぐち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{待|ま}っ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧てて」 (Wait at the north exit). The area around each exit often has a distinct character — different shops, bus routes, and landmarks.
